title: Order
description: A request to design a voice (type voice, from a design sheet or from a human audio sample) or generate a line (type line). Type sound is reserved for F7.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

key.description: Order key: the voice key for a voice order, the line key for a line order.

type.description: Order type; sound is reserved for a later phase.

testText.description: voice: test sentence spoken in every take.

locale.description: voice: language variant (optional with a design sheet, required with a sample); a line takes the one of its voice.

designSheet.description: voice: design sheet the instruct is built from.

voice.description: line: key of the voice that speaks.

sample.description: voice: a human audio sample to clone (Base models) instead of a design sheet. The audio is copied into the order and becomes one take (source sample); a sample voice makes no design takes, and has no seed or test text.

audio.description: Path of the WAV file (a relative path is resolved by the caller: the CLI uses the folder of the order file).

sampling.description: voice (design sheet) or line: sampling parameters of its takes; missing fields come from the project configuration and then the engine catalog. A line does not inherit the sampling of its voice. Not allowed with a sample.
